title: HER NAME
subtitle: a dark fantasy
_structure_note: Extended to ~3 minutes. The 72-second version failed emotionally because it was one note: grim throughout. An audience cannot feel a loss it was never given anything to lose. So Act 1 is now entirely WARM - we meet Mira, we watch her braid a crimson cord onto Kael's wrist, we hear her voice. Everything after that is the audience watching Kael pay away things they personally witnessed. The final payment (c02_mira_face) is deliberately the same image as the first payment (06_memory) shot closer and destroyed completely. The cord is planted in a03_cord and paid off in c05_cord_final: at the end Kael is holding the only surviving trace of her sister and does not know what it is. The viewer remembers. She does not. That gap is the whole point of the film.
_style_note: 2D anime needs the negative as much as the prompt. `neg_all` repeats '3d render, photorealistic, cgi' on every shot because Qwen otherwise drifts back to a 3D render within a few shots. step_print 12 gives the finished cut 12 distinct frames per second - hand-drawn animation is shot 'on twos', and that stepped cadence is a large part of why anime does not read as live action.

shots.prompt: Heroic low angle of {KAEL} risen to full height with the enormous black sword raised overhead in both hands and now blazing with crimson fire along its whole length, hair and tattered cloak whipping violently upward, ash blasting away from her in a ring, eyes blank and burning white, backlit silhouette, immense dynamic power
shots.motion: She rises and hauls the blazing sword up overhead. Crimson fire runs along the blade. Her hair and cloak whip violently upward. Ash blasts away from her feet in an expanding ring.
shots.sfx: Roaring magical ignition, rushing crimson fire, blasting ash, rising choir and brass, guttural scream

shots.neg: calm, closed mouth, quiet, static, portrait, gentle
shots.prompt: Extreme close-up of {KAEL} screaming with her whole body, mouth wide open, tendons standing out in her neck, eyes blazing blank white with crimson light, blood and ash on her face, hair blasted straight back, radial speed lines, the most human sound in the film coming out of something that has stopped being human
shots.motion: She screams, mouth wide, tendons standing out, hair blasted straight back by the force of it. Blank white light floods her eyes. Speed lines radiate outward violently.
shots.sfx: Raw tearing scream, roaring magical fire, full orchestral and choral peak, distortion

shots.neg: figures visible, detailed characters, calm, dim, static
shots.prompt: Extreme wide anime finishing frame, almost entirely abstract: one enormous blade-thin diagonal slash of blinding white and crimson light cutting clean across the whole composition from corner to corner, the colossal antlered silhouette splitting apart along the cut, everything else pure black, minimal and graphic, single decisive stroke
shots.motion: The blade of light cuts across the frame in one instant sweep and the colossal silhouette splits apart along the cut, halves sliding away from each other. Light floods, then collapses.
shots.sfx: Single enormous decisive blade strike, air splitting, deep resonant boom, ringing aftertone, choir cutting out

shots.prompt: Wide shot of {BEAST} coming apart in total silence, the colossal skull and antlers crumbling into drifting black ash and pale green sparks that rise upward instead of falling, the empty sockets going dark, a small black-armoured figure standing motionless below with sword lowered
shots.motion: The vast skull and antlers crumble slowly into drifting black ash and rising green sparks. The witchfire in the sockets fades and goes out. Everything rises upward. The small figure below does not move.
shots.sfx: Vast crumbling bone, rising ember shimmer, magic dissipating, wind returning, deep silence beneath

shots.prompt: Wide shot of {KAEL} standing completely alone in a vast field of grey ash under a colourless sky, the black sword point-down in the ground beside her, her shoulders rising and falling, the ruined forest reduced to bare stumps around her, immense emptiness
shots.motion: Her shoulders rise and fall slowly with heavy breathing. Ash falls. The sword stands point-down beside her. She does not otherwise move. Very slow gentle drift back.
shots.sfx: Cold wind across open ash, exhausted heavy breathing, faint distant embers, vast emptiness

shots.prompt: Tight close-up of {KAEL}'s face as the resolve drains out of it and is replaced by a slow dawning bewilderment, her dull silver eyes searching, brow drawing together, mouth slightly open, ash on her lashes, blood drying on her temple, utterly lost
shots.motion: The hardness leaves her face. Her eyes search left and right, unfocused. Her brow draws together. Her mouth opens slightly. She blinks slowly, confused.

line.text: It is finished. The bargain is kept. I always keep a bargain.

shots.prompt: Extreme close-up of {KAEL}'s face, silver eyes wide and searching for something that is not there any more, one tear cutting a clean track down through the ash and dried blood on her cheek, lips parting to speak, ash falling slowly past, devastating quiet grief
shots.motion: Her eyes search desperately for something no longer there. Her lips part to speak. A single tear cuts a clean track down through the ash. Ash falls slowly past. She holds absolutely still.

line.text: Wait. Who was it? Who was I doing this for?

shots.prompt: Close-up of the crimson rune in {SWORD} now completely dark and cold, the metal dull and pitted, no light in it at all, ash beginning to settle on the blade, the chains hanging slack and dead, an absolute and final silence made visible
shots.motion: Nothing happens. Ash settles slowly onto the dead black metal. The rune does not light. The chains hang slack. The stillness holds far longer than is comfortable.
shots.sfx: Ash settling on metal, one distant hollow wind gust, no music, profound and total silence

shots.prompt: Wide shot from behind of {KAEL} some distance out into the endless grey ashfall, stopped dead mid-stride, the enormous sword dragging in the ash behind her, her head tilted slightly down as though she has noticed something on her own body, tiny against an empty white-grey void
shots.motion: She has stopped walking. She stands motionless for a long moment. Then her head tilts slowly downward to look at her own left wrist. Ash falls heavily around her.
shots.sfx: Dragging footsteps stopping abruptly, heavy ash falling, wind, one slow breath

shots.prompt: Extreme close-up of {KAEL}'s bare left wrist held up in front of her, the frayed filthy braided crimson cord still knotted around it, blood and ash worked into the braid, her other hand reaching to touch it with complete blank incomprehension, ash falling past, the last surviving trace of something she no longer has any word for
shots.motion: Her fingers touch the frayed cord and turn it slowly around her wrist, examining it without any recognition at all. She almost pulls at the knot. Then she stops, and closes her whole hand around it instead, and holds it. Ash falls.
shots.sfx: Cloth and braid creaking softly under fingers, ash falling, one long unsteady breath, a single fragment of the warm folk melody on solo erhu, unbearably distant

shots.prompt: Final extreme wide shot from behind of {KAEL} walking slowly away from camera into endless grey ashfall, the enormous black sword dragging behind her and cutting a single long furrow in the ash, her figure shrinking, no horizon and no landmark anywhere, only white-grey emptiness ahead, nothing at all behind her
shots.motion: She walks slowly away from camera into the ashfall, the sword dragging and cutting a single long furrow behind her. Ash falls heavily. Her figure grows smaller and dimmer until nearly lost. Slow crane up.
shots.sfx: Slow heavy dragging footsteps, blade scraping through ash, endless cold wind, mournful distant tone, fading to nothing
